1. मे cl. 1. Ā. (Dhātup. xxii, 65) मयते (ep. also P. मयति; pf. ममे Gr.; aor. अमास्त, ib.; fut. माता, मास्यते, ib.; ind.p. -मित्य or -माय, ib.). to exchange, barter (cf. अप-. and नि-√ मे) :
Caus. मापयति, ib. :
Desid. मित्सते, ib. :
Intens. मेमीयते, मामेति, मामाति, ib.
2. मे (onomat.) imitative of the sound of a bleating goat (मे-मे-√ कृ, to bleat), Kāv.
